cases.rule: Implementation remains Software Development unless independent quality assessment is separately requested or materially needed.
QA owns readiness evidence; Release Engineering owns promotion/deploy mechanics.
Quality Engineering is not the design owner.
Independent verification may pair with the design owner for acceptance truth.
Playwright is an execution surface/reference, not the primary faculty identity.
Quality Engineering does not replace Security Engineering.
Blind reruns cannot be used as readiness evidence.
Automated accessibility evidence is partial and cannot support a universal accessibility claim.
